## LightMoss v0.3.9: a cleaner power-off on the R36S

**R36S (G80CA):** at power-off and restart, LightMoss now ends whatever spruce left running before it unmounts the spruce
card, giving a game still open a few seconds to save. The card is then unmounted cleanly instead of in the system's last
pass. The same happens if spruce restarts after a crash, so two copies of spruce never run side by side. The Mini V2
has done this since v0.2.x; dArkMoss made the same fix this week.

**Mini V2:** no change.
